svg.title: Review: diffraction - change the opening
svg.desc: Same wavelength and same plotting scale. Angular-spectrum wavefronts for openings of width four wavelengths and one wavelength. Solid crests and dashed troughs are a scalar wave model, not a photograph.
svg.text: Same wavelength. Narrower opening: greater angular spreading.
Model wavefronts for a uniformly illuminated opening; compare the spreading.
